key_insight: LLM-guided symbolic search discovers simple inventory-policy templates that improve empirical performance and expose replenishment mechanisms suitable for mathematical analysis.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers compact decision rules for inventory systems with lead times, perishability, or limited customer patience, while fitting parameters separately for each instance.
method: LLMs revise symbolic policy structures; a numerical engine fits parameters and evaluates policies.
Multicriteria selection, state-specific diagnostics, and reusable symbolic motifs guide structural evolution.
A three-stage progression develops shared templates across instances and configurations with varying state dimensions.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covers 15,600 instances across 50 demand distributions; discovered templates outperform evaluated simple-formula benchmarks in aggregate and are competitive with policies requiring more elaborate online computation.
watch_item: The strict theoretical advantage applies only to a specialized three-period lead-time setting under specified demand and cost conditions, not to every discovered template or configuration.
paper_title: Agentic Discovery of Simple Symbolic Inventory Policies
